[[LINE07]]         self.__balance = initial

[[LINE10]]         if (amount > 0) :

[[LINE12]]         return self.__balance

[[LINE15]]         if (amount > 0 and fee >= 0 and amount+fee < self.__balance) :
[[LINE16]]             self.__balance = self.__balance - amount - fee
[[LINE17]]         return self.__balance
[[LINE18]]     #Khatwa 1.4: Ta3reef tareeqa li-izafat al-faida ila al-hesab
[[LINE19]]     def add_interest(self) :
[[LINE20]]         self.__balance += (self.__balance * 0.035)
[[LINE21]]         return self.__balance
[[LINE22]]     #Khatwa 1.5: Ta3reef al-turuq li-istirja3 halat al-hesab

[[LINE24]]         return self.__acct_name
[[LINE25]]     def get_balance(self) :
[[LINE26]]         return self.__balance
[[LINE27]]     def get_acct_number(self) :
[[LINE28]]         return self.__acct_number

[[LINE36]] print("Rasid {:s} ba3d al-idraaj: {:.2f}".format(acct2.get_name(), acct2.withdraw (480, 1.50)))
